0 / 未设置 = 不清理；下限 7 天。: 0 / unset = do not clean up; minimum 7 days.
0 / 未设置 = 不清理；下限 7 天，低于下限视为配置错误，该目标跳过。: 0 / unset = do not clean up; minimum 7 days. A value below the minimum is treated as a configuration error and the target is skipped.
Binlog 解析 / 回滚结果的条数与体积上限: Row and size limits for Binlog parse / rollback results
DDL 完成后额外通知的权限组: Permission groups to notify after DDL completes
JSON，覆盖内置的 P0 / P1 / P2 阈值。: JSON that overrides the built-in P0 / P1 / P2 thresholds.
JSON：规则名 → 级别。非法值记日志并用默认规则。: JSON: rule name → level. Invalid values are logged and the default rules are used.
SOAR 会在该库里建表、删表: SOAR creates and drops tables in this database
SOAR 可执行文件的绝对路径，文件名必须是 soar。未配置时优化页提示未配置: Absolute path of the SOAR executable; the file name must be soar. Until it is set, the optimizer page reports it as not configured (409).
SOAR 程序、配置文件与测试环境（仅超级用户可改，保存时会校验文件与测试库地址: SOAR program, config file and test environment (superusers only; the files and the test database address are verified when saved)
SQL 导出工单是否按脱敏规则处理；关闭后导出原值。: Whether SQL export workflows apply the masking rules; when off, original values are exported.
always=执行了语句或失败就推: always=Notify when statements ran or failed
dbt_query_log（含完整查询语句）。0 / 未设置 = 不清理；下限: dbt_query_log (contains full query statements). 0 / unset = do not clean up; minimum 7 days.
raw 会在命中记录里保存语句原文，可能包含敏感数据: raw stores the original statement in hit records, which may contain sensitive data
warning=出现警告或错误即驳回: warning=Reject on any warning or error
“goInception 配置”页读写的 config.toml。: The config.toml read and written by the "goInception settings" page.
“日志解析”页里“最多条数”能填的最大值。结果全部放在服务内存里，条数很多时占用: The largest value allowed for “Max rows” on the Binlog parsing page. Results are held entirely in server memory, so very large counts use a lot of it; raise it only as needed.
“日志解析”页里“结果体积上限”能填的最大值。结果全部放在服务内存里，下载时还要: The largest value allowed for “Result size limit” on the Binlog parsing page. Results are held entirely in server memory and a download needs a second copy; do not set it too high.
“预估扫描行数”条件取事实时的限时。: Time limit when the "estimated rows scanned" condition fetches facts.
不属于任何计划的报告的保留天数；未设置 = 永不清理。: Retention days for reports that do not belong to any plan; unset = never cleaned up.
两步验证的短信通道；未启用时用户不能绑定短信验证。: The SMS channel for two-factor authentication; when disabled, users cannot bind SMS verification.
会话 Cookie 不带过期时间，关闭浏览器后需要重新登录。: The session cookie has no expiry time, so users must sign in again after closing the browser.
允许使用 API 的用户 ID: User IDs allowed to use the API
允许用户在“外部账号绑定”页自行绑定 / 解绑。: Allow users to bind / unbind on the "External account bindings" page themselves.
允许用户自行绑定外部账号: Allow users to bind external accounts themselves
关闭后在线查询返回原值，脱敏规则暂不生效。: When off, online queries return original values and masking rules do not take effect.
关闭后导出文件里是未脱敏的原值: When off, exported files contain unmasked original values
关闭后所有规则暂停执行，也不再记录命中。: When off, all rules are suspended and hits are no longer recorded.
关闭后脱敏出错时，查询结果会以未脱敏状态返回给用户: When off and masking fails, query results are returned to the user unmasked
关闭时 goInception 检查的工单不生成备份；仅对 goInceptio: When off, workflows checked by goInception do not generate backups; only applies to checks from goInception.
关闭浏览器即退出: Sign out when the browser closes
关闭：PRINT 只作为信息显示在该语句的“信息”里；开启：收到 PRINT 就: Off: PRINT is only shown as information in the statement's "Info"; On: a PRINT is treated as a failure and the unit is rolled back.
出现警告或错误即驳回: Reject on any warning or error
分区表自动续建与过期删除: Automatic creation and expiry deletion of partitions
删除已结束导出工单的 zip 文件，工单记录保留。0 / 未设置 = 不清理；下: Deletes the zip files of finished export workflows; workflow records are kept. 0 / unset = do not clean up; minimum 7 days.
到期数据会被物理删除，不可恢复（开启“启用保留策略清理”后才会执行）: Expired data is physically deleted and cannot be recovered (only runs after "Enable retention cleanup" is turned on)
只有 SQL Server 实例并发执行，其余类型严格串行。: Only SQL Server instances run concurrently; other types run strictly in sequence.
可用分区数回到阈值以上时，推送一条“已恢复”。: Push a "recovered" message when the number of available partitions is back at or above the threshold.
可用分区数小于它就告警；单张表可以在“分区维护”页里单独设置（填 0 = 这张表: Alert when the number of available partitions is below this value. Each table can have its own value on the "Partition maintenance" page (0 = no alerts for that table). Do not set it above a table's "pre-created partitions + 1": it can never be reached even after partitions are added, so it would alert forever.
可用分区数（上界晚于当前时间的分区个数，含当前分区，不含 MAXVALUE 分区: When the number of available partitions (partitions whose upper bound is later than now, including the current one and excluding the MAXVALUE partition) is below the threshold, the table is flagged in the "Partition maintenance" list and a message is pushed to the channels enabled under "Push settings" at each check. The check interval is the same as the automatic maintenance interval, and checks run even when automatic maintenance is off.
可用变量：{账号} {姓名} {部门} {IP} {日期} {时间}；必须包含: Available variables: account, name, department, {IP}, date and time (write their Chinese names inside braces, as in the default value); must contain the account or name variable; at most 60 characters.
可选：SOAR 的 -config 配置文件（绝对路径）。: Optional: the config file passed to SOAR with -config (absolute path).
各类日志 / 记录 / 文件的保留与清理节奏: Retention and cleanup schedule for logs / records / files
合规数据：先确认公司审计保留期。0 / 未设置 = 不清理；下限 30 天。: Compliance data: confirm your company's audit retention period first. 0 / unset = do not clean up; minimum 30 days.
周末不发 P2 / P3 通知。: Do not send P2 / P3 notifications at weekends.
命中的 DDL 在提交检查时直接按高危驳回。Go（RE2）正则语法。: DDL matching this is rejected as high-risk at submission check. Go (RE2) regex syntax.
命中的语句不自动通过；为空用内置规则（alter / create / drop: Matching statements are not auto-approved; when empty the built-in rules are used (alter / create / drop / truncate / rename / delete, etc.).
回填外部账号唯一 ID: Backfill the external account's unique ID
在页面上叠加姓名、账号和时间，用于截图溯源。: Overlay the name, account and time on pages to trace screenshots.
外部登录也要两步验证: Require two-factor authentication for external sign-in too
外部账号首次登录时按哪些字段匹配已有用户，可选 username、email、t: Which fields are used to match existing users when an external account signs in for the first time: username, email, third_id, phone, comma-separated; when empty only already-bound external identities are recognized.
审核引擎与备份库的连接: Connections to the review engine and the backup database
导出工单最多导出多少行；结果全部读进内存，别调太大。: Maximum number of rows an export workflow can export; the whole result is read into memory, so do not set it too high.
导出文件的存放位置与上限: Location and limits of export files
巡检报告保留与旧定时: Inspection report retention and legacy schedule
开启后不发任何性能工单通知。: When on, no performance workflow notifications are sent.
开启后到期的数据会被物理删除，不可恢复: When on, expired data is physically deleted and cannot be recovered
开启后到点自动为分区表续建分区（只续建；删除靠下面的开关；REORGANIZE: When on, partitions of partitioned tables are created automatically on schedule (creation only; deletion depends on the switch below; REORGANIZE and initialization are never automatic).
开启后同一工单里不允许同时有 DDL 与 DML。: When on, a single workflow cannot contain both DDL and DML.
开启后在线查询拒绝 select *。: When on, online queries reject select *.
开启后提交人不能审批自己的工单。: When on, submitters cannot approve their own workflows.
开启后新密码必须同时包含字母、数字与特殊字符。: When on, new passwords must contain letters, digits and special characters.
开启后服务会定时在目标库上执行分区 DDL: When on, the service periodically runs partition DDL on target databases
开启后本服务会自动采集 / 建单 / 通知: When on, this service automatically collects, creates workflows and sends notifications
开启后用户登录必须完成两步验证。: When on, users must complete two-factor authentication to sign in.
开启后符合条件的工单不经人工审批直接通过: When on, workflows that meet the conditions are approved without manual approval
开启后自动删除超过保留期的分区。: When on, partitions older than the retention period are dropped automatically.
开启后超级用户不能通过外部登录方式进入。: When on, superusers cannot sign in through external sign-in methods.
开启才按备份存储的“保留天数”删除超期的备份对象（总开关之外的第二道开关）。: Only when on are expired backup objects deleted according to the backup storage's "retention days" (a second switch besides the master switch).
开启：脱敏出错时不返回数据；关闭：放行未脱敏的结果并提示。: On: no data is returned when masking fails; Off: unmasked results are allowed through with a notice.
形如 22-9（22 点到次日 9 点不发非紧急通知）。: Like 22-9 (no non-urgent notifications from 22:00 to 09:00 the next day).
总开关、全局模式与出错策略（规则在“SQL 防火墙”页面维护）: Master switch, global mode and error policy (rules are maintained on the "SQL firewall" page)
总开关，缺省关闭；各目标的保留天数没设置（或为 0）时不清理。建议先只设天数、不: Master switch, off by default; targets with no retention days (or 0) are not cleaned up. It is recommended to set the days first without turning the master switch on and to confirm the amounts with the preview.
执行了语句或失败就推: Notify when statements ran or failed
持续不足时每隔多久再提醒一次；0 = 不重复，只在首次不足时推一次。: How often to remind again while the shortage continues; 0 = never repeat, push only when the shortage first appears.
按用户名等依据匹配成功后，记下外部唯一 ID，之后即使外部用户名变化也认这个绑定: After matching by username etc. succeeds, the external unique ID is recorded, and the binding is still recognized even if the external username changes later.
放宽这个正则会让更多语句不经人工审批通过: Loosening this regex lets more statements pass without manual approval
新密码至少多少位（含修改、重置与新建用户）。: Minimum length of new passwords (including changes, resets and new users).
新用户默认加入的权限组名称，逗号分隔（登录方式自己配置了就用它的）。: Names of the permission groups new users join by default, comma-separated (a sign-in method's own configuration takes precedence).
新用户默认加入的资源组名称，逗号分隔（登录方式自己配置了就用它的）。: Names of the resource groups new users join by default, comma-separated (a sign-in method's own configuration takes precedence).
新用户默认权限组: Default permission groups for new users
新用户默认资源组: Default resource groups for new users
查询结果脱敏总开关: Master switch for query result masking
查询超时、行数 / 字节上限、结果脱敏: Query timeout, row / byte limits, result masking
格式 用户:密码@主机:端口/库名。必须是非生产库（SOAR 会在其中建临时表）: Format user:password@host:port/database. It must be a non-production database (SOAR creates temporary tables in it). Stored encrypted; on save it is checked not to be a registered production instance.
检查结果有问题时是否由系统直接驳回。: Whether the system rejects directly when the check result has problems.
模板里放验证码的变量名。: The variable name that holds the verification code in the template.
每个目标每轮最多删除的行数。: Maximum rows deleted per target per round.
没套消息模板时，默认通知文案里怎么显示 SQL。: How SQL is shown in the default notification text when no message template is applied.
申请 API 令牌需两步验证: Require two-factor authentication to request an API token
登录会话多久不活动后失效。: How long a sign-in session may be inactive before it expires.
登录锁定、密码与会话、两步验证、自助注册、页面水印: Sign-in lockout, passwords and sessions, two-factor authentication, self-registration, page watermark
登录页是否显示注册入口。: Whether the sign-in page shows the registration entry.
目前只支持本地目录。: Only local directories are supported for now.
相对路径时相对环境变量 EXPORT_BASE_DIR；不能含 ..；服务账号需: A relative path is relative to the EXPORT_BASE_DIR environment variable; cannot contain ..; the service account needs write permission on it.
短信两步验证使用的短信服务商与密钥: SMS provider and keys used for SMS two-factor authentication
空 = 全部阶段都通知；否则只通知列出的阶段：Pass、Execute、Canc: Empty = notify on all phases; otherwise only the listed phases are notified: Pass, Execute, Cancel (comma-separated; new workflow submission is not controlled by this).
符合下面全部条件的工单不经人工审批直接通过。: Workflows meeting all of the conditions below are approved without manual approval.
观察模式下规则只记录命中，不拦截。: In observe mode rules only record hits and do not block.
让 goInception 精确计算影响行数（real_row_count），而: Make goInception count affected rows exactly (real_row_count) instead of estimating.
该文件由 SOAR 读取，决定它的行为: SOAR reads this file and its behavior depends on it
该路径指向服务器上会被执行的程序: This path points to a program the server will execute
调大会让更多大批量更新不经人工审批通过: Raising this lets more bulk updates pass without manual approval
账号被锁定后多少秒内不能登录。: How many seconds an account cannot sign in after being locked.
超出只返回前面的行并提示；结果全部读进内存，别调太大。: When exceeded, only the leading rows are returned with a notice; the whole result is read into memory, so do not set it too high.
超出的单元格被截断并提示；生成脚本类的查询一个格子就是几百 KB，别调太小。: Cells that exceed it are truncated with a notice; a script-generating query can produce hundreds of KB in one cell, so do not set it too low.
超时后发 KILL QUERY 终止这条查询。: After the timeout KILL QUERY is sent to terminate the query.
超期的归档备份会被删除，不可恢复: Expired archive backups are deleted and cannot be recovered
超级用户 / 有全实例查询权限 / 资源组实例查询时的行数上限。: Row limit for superusers / users with all-instance query permission / resource group instance queries.
超级用户只能本地登录: Superusers can only sign in locally
过期分区里的数据会被删除，不可恢复: Data in expired partitions is deleted and cannot be recovered
连续登录失败达到这个次数后锁定账号。: The account is locked after this many consecutive sign-in failures.
逗号分隔的用户 ID；为空表示不限制。: Comma-separated user IDs; empty means no restriction.
逗号分隔：collect、sla、verify、report；空 = 全部关闭。: Comma-separated: collect, sla, verify, report; empty = all off. Re-read every minute; no restart needed.
通过 LDAP / OIDC 等外部登录方式进入的用户，是否仍要完成平台的两步验: Whether users signing in through external methods such as LDAP / OIDC must still complete the platform's two-factor authentication.
配置了外部登录方式后，登录页上本地账号表单的显示方式。: How the local account form is displayed on the sign-in page once external sign-in methods are configured.
间隔在空转时同样生效：从关到开最长要等一个间隔。: The interval also applies while idle: after switching from off to on you may wait up to one interval.
防火墙求值本身出错时放行还是拒绝。: Whether to allow or deny when the firewall's own evaluation fails.
附加在水印后面的固定文字，最长 40 个字符。: Fixed text appended to the watermark, at most 40 characters.
需要同时打开“归档备份文件清理开关”。0 / 未设置 = 不清理；下限 7 天。: Requires the "Archive backup file cleanup switch" to be on as well. 0 / unset = do not clean up; minimum 7 days.
高危 DDL、自动审批与驳回、备份、批量工单并发: High-risk DDL, automatic approval and rejection, backups, batch workflow concurrency
